verses.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲלֹ֥ות הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־צִיֹּ֥ון לֹא־יִ֝מֹּ֗וט לְעֹולָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ اَلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ مِثْلُ جَبَلِ صِهْيَوْنَ، ٱلَّذِي لَا يَتَزَعْزَعُ، بَلْ يَسْكُنُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. They that trust in the LORD are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. They that trust in the LORD [shall be] as mount Zion, [which] cannot be removed, [but] abideth for ever.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

verses.he: יְֽרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֪יב לָ֥הּ וַ֭יהוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמֹּ֑ו מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: أُورُشَلِيمُ ٱلْجِبَالُ حَوْلَهَا، وَٱلرَّبُّ حَوْلَ شَعْبِهِ مِنَ ٱلْآنَ وَإِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.en: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about His people, from this time forth and for ever.
verses.kjv: As the mountains [are] round about Jerusalem, so the LORD [is] round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.web: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גֹּורַ֪ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا تَسْتَقِرُّ عَصَا ٱلْأَشْرَارِ عَلَى نَصِيبِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ، لِكَيْلَا يَمُدَّ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.en: For the rod of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; that the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.web: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

verses.ar: أَحْسِنْ يَارَبُّ إِلَى ٱلصَّالِحِينَ وَإِلَى ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِي ٱلْقُلُوبِ.
verses.en: Do good, O LORD, unto the good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.kjv: Do good, O LORD, unto [those that be] good, and [to them that are] upright in their hearts.
verses.web: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

verses.he: וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עַֽקַלְקַלֹּותָ֗ם יֹולִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝לֹ֗ום עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْعَادِلُونَ إِلَى طُرُقٍ مُعْوَجَّةٍ فَيُذْهِبُهُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ مَعَ فَعَلَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ. سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: [but] peace [shall be] upon Israel.
verses.web: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
